originalTitle: Trump is making it easier for fossil fuel companies to leak methane

content: In its latest gift to oil and gas companies, the Trump administration is expected to announce plans today to weaken rules that guard against methane leaks. Methane is a smog-forming pollutant and a powerful greenhouse gas that’s up to 80 times as potent as carbon dioxide on a 20-year horizon. It’s the primary component of what the fossil fuel industry calls “natural gas” that routinely leaks from oil and gas wells and pipelines. The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is reversing course on its previous efforts to plug those leaks. As part of President Donald Trump’s deregulatory agenda, the EPA plans to undo Biden-era rules that were expected to cut methane emissions by 80 percent over 14 years. The EPA teased the rule change earlier this month, saying in a press release that it was “days away” from making the proposal. EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin says the rollbacks will save oil and gas companies $45 billion, while the previous rules would have incurred $18 billion in regulatory costs. “This proposal takes on many of the problems American [oil and gas] producers and operators have raised with us,” Zeldin said in the October 7th press release. “The Trump EPA is committed to fixing this so the U.S. can reach its full energy potential.” The agency is expected to step back standards for so-called “marginal wells” — old wells that produce little fuel but create an outsize amount of methane pollution from leaks. These wells are responsible for half of the industry’s methane emissions despite only producing 6 percent of US oil and gas, ProPublica reports. The EPA is also expected to end the Super Emitter Program that notified oil and gas infrastructure operators of large releases of methane reaching 100 kilograms per hour or more. Trump plans to make the announcement from a campaign rally in Lubbock, Texas, today, Bloomberg reports. Not only is Texas the top oil- and gas-producing state in the US, it’s also the world’s biggest data center market. With more data center capacity under construction than any other state, Texas has become emblematic of the challenges energy-intensive AI models pose. In just five years, data centers could undo decades of air quality improvements in Texas, according to a recent report by the Houston Advanced Research Center. Methane has caused about 30 percent of global warming so far. But unlike carbon dioxide, which can linger in the atmosphere for hundreds or thousands of years, methane dissipates in a little over a decade. That makes eliminating methane emissions, particularly from unintentional leaks, one of the fastest and most straightforward ways to stop global temperatures from rising. The EPA’s rollbacks quickly triggered furor from health and environmental advocates. “Any proposed rollback to the federal methane rule is a slap in the face to families who are exposed to oil and gas pollution where they live, work, and play,” Celerah Hewes, a senior manager for state field campaigns at Moms Clean Air Force, said in an email ahead of the expected announcement. “For over a decade, [our group] has been fighting for methane protections for our families—and we were making progress. Today’s announcement from EPA is a massive blow to the efforts to safeguard our children’s health and our climate.” The Biden-era methane rules were estimated to bring in up to $98 billion in benefits by reducing climate risks and health costs from air pollution, even after factoring in the costs of compliance. Plugging leaks was supposed to lead to up to $13 billion worth of recovered natural gas.
chineseTitle: 特朗普正在让化石燃料公司更容易泄漏甲烷
chineseSummary: 在给石油和天然气公司的最新礼物中，特朗普政府预计将在今天宣布削弱防止甲烷泄漏的规定的计划。甲烷是一种会形成烟雾的污染物，也是一种强大的温室气体，在 20 年内其效力高达二氧化碳的 80 倍。它是[…]的主要组成部分
chineseContent: 在给石油和天然气公司的最新礼物中，特朗普政府预计将在今天宣布削弱防止甲烷泄漏的规定的计划。甲烷是一种会形成烟雾的污染物，也是一种强大的温室气体，在 20 年内其效力高达二氧化碳的 80 倍。它是化石燃料行业所谓的“天然气”的主要组成部分，经常从油气井和管道中泄漏。美国环境保护署 (EPA) 正在改变之前堵塞这些漏洞的努力。作为唐纳德·特朗普总统放松管制议程的一部分，美国环保局计划废除拜登时代的规定，这些规定预计将在 14 年内将甲烷排放量减少 80%。美国环保局本月早些时候对规则的改变进行了调侃，并在一份新闻稿中表示，距离提出提案“还有几天”。 EPA 署长 Lee Zeldin 表示，此次调整将为石油和天然气公司节省 450 亿美元，而之前的规则将产生 180 亿美元的监管成本。 “这项提案解决了美国（石油和天然气）生产商和运营商向我们提出的许多问题，”泽尔丁在 10 月 7 日的新闻稿中表示。 “特朗普环保局致力于解决这个问题，以便美国能够充分发挥其能源潜力。”预计该机构将降低所谓“边缘井”的标准，即生产很少燃料但因泄漏而产生大量甲烷污染的老井。据 ProPublica 报道，尽管这些井只生产了美国 6% 的石油和天然气，但其甲烷排放量却占该行业的一半。预计 EPA 还将终止超级排放者计划，该计划向石油和天然气基础设施运营商通报甲烷大量释放，达到每小时 100 公斤或更多。特朗普计划于
